messages.subject: Dubai Executive Search Introduction | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Singh,

Your work through Peergrowth on C-suite and senior leadership search from Dubai across the Middle East, Africa and South Asia makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where growth, public-sector engagement, institutional trust, reputation and responsible development must be managed together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC.

I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments. My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate searches across energy, resources, industrials, external affairs, ESG and country leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
